action_mapping: Fold (-1): if mask_free_fold and the spot is a free check (to_call == 0 and check/call is legal), rewrite the target to check_call (id 1); otherwise the target is fold (id 0). Check/call (0) maps to check_call (id 1). Any other code is a wager: -2 (all-in) has chip amount equal to the actor's remaining stack; a positive code's chip amount is that extra. Candidates are the legal subset of raise_min (id 2), raise_large (id 3), and all_in (id 4). The target is the candidate with the smallest absolute chip difference. A tie goes to the smaller action id (raise_min, then raise_large, then all_in).

arrays.env_legal_mask: float32 [N, 5], environment mask before the free-fold drop
arrays.game_id: int64 [N], hand index, for a later holdout by games
arrays.probs: float32 [N, 5], one-hot of actions (deterministic teacher for KL)
arrays.to_call: float32 [N], chips owed at the decision

bc_training: Not run by this script. A later KL run should load these token fields and probs. scripts/train_bc.py still rebuilds transformer rows from c_1048 meta_json and will not load this npz unchanged.

env_version.note: Raise sizes and legality come from legal.py at git_commit. Generated on main, before PR #33 aligns the minimum raise with the Botzone judge. After #33 merges, regenerate the 200k set; do not train on a mix of the two raise ladders.

opponent_mix.epsilon_meaning: With probability epsilon the opponent plays uniform over environment-legal action ids; otherwise it plays the mapped rule-bot target.
opponent_mix.random_meaning: Uniform over environment-legal action ids. A random opponent may fold a free check. Those seats are not recorded.
opponent_mix.rule_meaning: The mapped rule-bot target, including the free-check fold rewrite.
opponent_mix.selection: one kind per hand, uniform over kinds, drawn before the hand

recorded_seat: hand_index % 2 (the data-policy seat). The other seat is the opponent mix.
